# Hermes Worlds & Game — 3D AI Agent Playgrounds

**Browser 3D worlds where you walk up to AI characters and talk to them.**

Hermes Worlds is a series of explorable 3D scenes (a western frontier town, a gold mine, a saloon) populated by AI characters you can converse with and take quests from. It demonstrates realtime agent chat inside a game loop — the same named-SSE event stream that powers the other clients.

## Highlights
- Interactive 3D environments with AI NPCs
- Realtime agent dialogue over streaming events
- Quest/objective system driven by the agent

## Stack
WebGL/Three.js, SSE chat, Node.js

## Live project
See the write-up, screenshots, and demo at https://sport.taila73942.ts.net/portfolio/project/hermes-worlds.html
